asked.item: Dental brand channel missing when connecting YouTube
Manager role shown in YouTube Studio
What to do to get the channel to appear

verdict.reason: The help pages say a channel may not appear when you are listed only as a Manager, and they give the fix.

steps.text: For branded or managed Youtube accounts, you typically need to click into your main account to see all the channels.
If you are listed only as a Manager, the channel may not appear when connecting.
Ask the current Owner to make you an Owner of the channel (or transfer ownership to you), then reconnect.
